meta.title: Sjórseiðr — site map
meta.note: Single source of truth for the home page's section cards and each section landing page (section.html?sec=<id>). Add a card here and it appears in both the section page and the home-page count.

sections.title: Chronicle
sections.blurb: The story so far, and where the ships have sailed — the event timeline and the season-by-season voyage map.

cards.title: Chronicle of Events
cards.desc: The covenant's full story timeline — verified history and proposed drafts awaiting review, season by season.

cards.title: Fleet Voyages by Season
cards.desc: A time-series map over the Mythic Europe chart — track each ship and magus season by season, with vis harvests and Tribunal covenants.

sections.title: Covenant
sections.blurb: The covenant itself and who crews its ships — the ledger, the playable sheets, the roster, and the dramatis personae.

cards.title: Covenant Sheet
cards.desc: Founding, charter, tribunal standing, aegis, loyalty, and covenant-wide virtues & flaws — the Ledger's Covenant tab.

cards.title: Playable Character Sheet
cards.desc: Live ArM5 sheets with dice, spell & combat rollers, in-play trackers, a roll log, and per-character export/import.

cards.title: Dramatis Personae
cards.desc: Foreign magi, dragons, faeries, and spirits who move through the story but don't crew a ship — click for full sheets.

cards.title: XP & Season Tracker
cards.desc: Every member's season-by-season activity and XP — filterable by type and by ship.

cards.title: Covenant Ledger
cards.desc: The covenant's true complexity over time — ships & land, labs, inhabitants, library, vis, and economics, with a running change log.

sections.title: Normandy Tribunal
sections.blurb: The 1223 Tribunal — its covenants, its tournament, and its prizes.

cards.title: The Normandy Tribunal — 1223
cards.desc: Interactive map of the Tribunal's covenants, with a toggle between covenant profiles and the tournament standings.

cards.title: Tribunal Workbook — 1223
cards.desc: Editable scoring workbook — vis sources, library prizes, and tournament brackets, loaded live from the data file.

cards.title: Vis Sources & Library
cards.desc: Reference catalogue of the Tribunal's known vis sources and library holdings.

sections.title: Reference
sections.blurb: Wider lore and rules — beyond the covenant's own waters.

cards.title: The Contested Isle: The Hibernian Tribunal
cards.desc: Extracted reference data for the Hibernian Tribunal — overview and regional maps for Connacht, Leinster, Meath, Munster, and Ulster.

cards.title: Reference
cards.desc: Miscellaneous GM tables — North Sea and Baltic sailing times between major ports, plus saga homebrew rulings.

cards.title: Integrating a New Magic System
cards.desc: GM rules reference — the Original Research → Breakthrough → Integration track for folding folk magic into Hermetic theory.

sections.title: Tools
sections.blurb: Build characters, and the rules data that feeds the archive.

cards.title: Character Creator
cards.desc: Guided Ars Magica character creation — magi, companions, and grogs — with rules and text drawn live from the armdef 0.5 corpus.

cards.title: Ars Magica Rule Set — .ttrpg
cards.desc: The full merged Ars Magica 5e rules definition (armdef 0.5) — every core book composed into a single titterpig .ttrpg by the synthesist, the source that feeds the archive's rollable sheets and verbatim rules text.

sections.title: Storyteller
sections.blurb: The Storyteller's working papers — open questions, rulings, and the candidate scenes for next session. Spoilers within; for the Game Master's eyes.

cards.title: Open Questions for the Storyteller
cards.desc: Questions needing a ruling, threads nobody's picked back up, and consequences still waiting to land.

cards.title: Next Session — Candidate Scenes
cards.desc: The Storyteller's working slate of scenes to stage next session, filterable by season and by magus.
